scope: read-only audit of ordinary funded browser post and worker atomic finalize; no chain operations

copyBenchmark.kind: local synthetic native-type copy microbenchmark; no chain or proof execution

findings: Tail validation detaches only native public inputs, not private execution or witness maps.
Native public-simulation and final transaction construction collect/sort class logs but do not deep-clone the private execution tree.
Previous log mutation affected in-memory execution/public-input and witness consistency, not canonical blockchain state. PXE staged local writes commit on operation success and discard on failure.
Both fixed-budget completeFeeOptions calls use supplied prices and cached wallet node info; repeated reconstruction is local, not repeated simulation or network round trip.
Remote proof serializes each witness once; circuitId hashes freshly assembled bytecode/VK data; encodeJob copies already-compressed witnesses into one wire buffer.
Current timing does not isolate circuit hashing, witness serialization and final wire packing, so no supported large-gain claim exists for eliminating copies.
candidate: If transport serialization becomes a target, split its existing numeric span into circuit-identity, witness serialization and wire packing before changing allocation/caching; do not cache mutable buffers by identity.
